mapper.select: SELECT c.class_id AS classId, c.user_id AS userId, c.class_title AS classTitle, c.description, c.class_price AS classPrice, c.class_category AS classCategory, c.class_create_date AS classCreateDate, c.class_permit AS classPermit, c.class_recom AS classRecom, c.class_level AS classLevel, c.file_no AS fileNo, f.file_url AS fileUrl FROM class c LEFT JOIN file f ON c.file_no = f.file_no WHERE c.class_id = #{classId}
mapper.update: UPDATE class SET class_permit = 'Y' WHERE class_id = #{classId}
UPDATE class SET class_permit = 'W' WHERE class_id = #{classId}
mapper.select: SELECT section_id AS sectionId, class_id As classId, section_title AS classTitle, class_permit AS classPermit FROM class_section WHERE class_id = #{classId}

SELECT cl.lesson_id AS lessonId, cl.section_id AS sectionId, cl.lesson_title AS lessonTitle, cl.file_no, f.file_url FROM class_lesson cl LEFT JOIN file f ON cl.file_no = f.file_no WHERE cl.section_id = #{sectionId} ORDER BY cl.lesson_id;

SELECT ib.block_id AS blockId, ib.class_id AS classId, ib.block_type AS blockType, be.element_id AS elementId, be.element_type AS elementType, be.element_content AS elementContent FROM introduce_block ib LEFT JOIN block_element be ON ib.block_id = be.block_id WHERE ib.class_id = #{classId}
SELECT element_id AS elementId, block_id AS blockId, element_type AS elementType, element_content AS elementContent FROM block_element WHERE block_id = #{blockId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admit_message (class_id, content, deny_at) VALUES (#{classId}, #{reason}, NOW());
mapper.select: SELECT c.class_id AS classId, c.user_id AS userId, c.class_title AS classTitle, c.class_create_date AS classCreateDate, u.name AS name FROM class c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.class_permit = 'N'
